notes.title: v1.2.3 UPDATE RELEASED!
notes.notes: We have finally fixed the black screen of death bug that some of you have been getting. So sorry to have taken so long. We fixed a bunch of other small stuff you probably wouldn't notice. But the black screen bug – oh, that was noticed.

notes.title: Quick Update
notes.notes:
We are close to finishing v1.1.7! We brought in a human game destroyer who spent hours basically crumbling the game down into a broken, weeping mess. He found bugs that only he could find, evidently. We've been fixing them all and the rough edges are being all smoothed-out.

This new version should be up by the weekend. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: New v1.1.3 Release
notes.notes:
We just released v1.1.3 on Steam. It contains bugfixes for some issues that were introduced in yesterday's v1.1.2; issues that we are very sorry were bothering your hard-earned Taco Trucks.

One important change we made is to ease up on the difficulty in both Easy and Normal mode. When you leave a city in Easy mode, one customer will die each time you leave. In Normal mode, all customers EXCEPT ONE will die. This allows you to return to cities and still have customers if you haven't run them all off by refusing service.

There are also some new Shop and Garage names. They're spectacular.

We are still working on the really cool, big update that has police in it. It's looking really great and we're making quick progress of it.

We are also working on improving the early game to make it more exciting and have some more variety. We love it the way it's balanced, but we can do better.

notes.title: New version 1.0.9
notes.notes:
This week we posted v1.0.7 and v1.0.8. Last night we posted v1.0.9, and we've been fixing all the small issues that we're finding or players are reporting.

We are also working on some additional gameplay you'll love. We will roll out a new feature soon, and we're developing a bigger gameplay feature right now.

We love making these additions. Soon we will have Steam Cards done.

notes.title: New version 1.0.6
notes.notes:
We just pushed an update to Gunman Taco Truck with the main fix being a font issue with Windows 7 computers. While doing this, we fixed a number of other issues. Here's our changelog:

    New font
    Options now save when the game exits from the options menu
    Escape no longer cancels orders in the taco builder
    Fixed the location of the buy gas button
    Added support for the escape key on desktop devices
    New Town FTUE step
    Strings now default to english if the string indexed is empty
    Localization of controls screen + “miles” on road signs
    Worldmap widescreen error fixed
    Weapon speedup on full-auto mode
    Updated strings_template.lua
    Fixed an issue with saving screenshots on Desktop
    Fixed an issue with mobile detection in the options
    Fixed a bug with achievement reporting on steam
    Improved performance of the cipher function
    Added new flurry hooks
    Added support for steamworks
    Added controls page to the options screen
    Fixed a bug where ingredients could get stuck beneath the taco
    Ingredients now clean up after you fold the taco
    Increased the amount of points you get for kills on hard
    Fixed a bug where certain projectiles could leak

The new build should be live on Steam shortly.
